security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links and code formatting. Two documented connector commands execute Python outside the audited bundle, and one requires a Resend API credential; use them only with user confirmation and reviewed connector code.

remediation.issue: The skill invokes a Resend connector outside the audited two-file bundle.
remediation.suggestion: Include the connector source in the publishable bundle or link to a pinned, independently reviewed version. Ask for explicit confirmation before running it.
Use a least-privilege, read-only credential, never display its value, and state the requested account scopes before execution.

remediation.issue: The DNS connector performs live DNS-over-HTTPS retrieval.
remediation.suggestion: State the destination and data requested before execution, and offer pasted DNS records as an offline alternative.

content.value_statement: Email teams can miss authentication and reputation issues until a campaign reaches spam folders. This skill creates an evidence-based pre-flight with clear gaps and next steps before sending.
actual_capabilities: Reviews supplied SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and optional BIMI evidence.
Classifies authentication evidence as pass, partial, veto-candidate, or unknown.
Assesses supplied reputation, bounce, and complaint metrics against stated checks.
Reviews seed-list placement for inbox, spam, and promotions outcomes.
Flags content, link, plain-text, and rendering risks in supplied email creative.
Returns a SEND-S score only when all applicable evidence is available.
limitations: It relies on DNS exports, DMARC reports, ESP reports, and seed tests supplied by the user.
It cannot prove mail authentication is passing without observed sending evidence.
It does not calculate the full email-quality score or enforce final sending vetoes.
The optional Resend and DNS connectors require separate review and execution approval.

use_cases.title: Pre-send campaign check
use_cases.description: Review authentication, placement, and hygiene evidence before a promotional campaign.

use_cases.title: Deliverability incident triage
use_cases.description: Identify likely causes when a program reaches spam or the Promotions tab.

use_cases.title: Sender readiness review
use_cases.description: Prepare an evidence summary for a new sending domain or scale-up decision.

prompt_templates.title: Basic pre-flight
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deliverability pre-flight for my sending domain. Tell me what evidence you need and give me a checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Authentication review
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI evidence. Here are my DNS export and DMARC aggregate report: [paste evidence].

prompt_templates.title: Placement and hygiene review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this seed-list placement test and ESP report. Assess reputation, bounce rate, complaint rate, and SEND-S readiness: [paste evidence].

prompt_templates.title: Complete launch decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a complete pre-send deliverability review for [domain] and [profile]. Use these DNS, DMARC, placement, creative, and ESP reports. List every evidence gap and do not score incomplete coverage.

output_examples.input: Review a DNS export with aligned SPF and DKIM, DMARC p=none, and no seed-list test.
output: Authentication: Partial. SPF and DKIM align; DMARC p=none needs monitoring.
Inbox placement: Needs input. No seed-list test was supplied.
Readiness: Not scored because applicable evidence is incomplete.

output_examples.input: Review an ESP report with a 0.35% complaint rate and spam-folder seed results.
output: List hygiene: Fail. Complaint rate exceeds the stated 0.3% threshold.
Inbox placement: Fail. Seed results show spam-folder placement.
Next step: Resolve delivery issues and provide new evidence before sending.

best_practices: Provide current DNS records, DMARC aggregate data, ESP metrics, and seed-list results together.
Treat unknown evidence as a gap and collect it before assigning a readiness score.
Use a separate final audit before a send or scale-up decision.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a DNS record as proof that live mail authentication passes.
Do not score readiness when an applicable check lacks evidence.
Do not share API keys or full subscriber data in the prompt.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It reviews evidence and produces a pre-flight assessment.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a sending domain, program profile, DNS records, DMARC aggregate report, ESP metrics, and seed-list test when available.

faq.question: Can it verify DMARC?
faq.answer: It can review supplied DNS and DMARC evidence. Passing mail requires observed sending evidence.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks the item as unknown or needs input and does not score incomplete coverage.

faq.question: Does it make the final send decision?
faq.answer: No. It hands verified evidence to a separate email-quality audit for final scoring and veto enforcement.

faq.question: Are API connectors required?
faq.answer: No. Manual exports and DNS evidence are supported. Optional connectors require separate approval and credential handling.
